title: Using a Production-Access Grant Issued Before the Access Policy Changed
scenario_text:
You are the on-call release manager at Corsica Systems. Engineer Priya needs to run a production deploy in the next hour to ship a customer-impacting fix. She has a standing production-access grant on file and wants to use it rather than wait on a new request.

Active policy: Production Access Policy PAP-4, effective 2024-09-01. Standing production-access grants ISSUED BEFORE 2024-09-01 remain valid until their scheduled 2025 recertification. Grants ISSUED ON OR AFTER 2024-09-01 require quarterly re-attestation by the service owner and automatically expire 90 days after issuance (or last attestation) if not re-attested; an expired grant cannot be used and the engineer must obtain a fresh, re-attested grant before deploying.

Prior decision A (2024-09-30): engineer 'Marcus' used his existing grant for a deploy with no re-attestation. Note: 'Grant issued 2024-06 under the prior policy; valid until 2025 recert.'

Prior decision B (2024-12-05): engineer 'Sana' was blocked from deploying on her grant and told to obtain a fresh one. Note: 'Grant issued 2024-10, over 90 days old, never re-attested; expired under PAP-4.'

Base facts: Priya's standing grant was issued 2024-07, before PAP-4 took effect, and its scheduled recertification is not until 2025. There is a genuine customer-impacting fix ready to ship.

Priya writes in Slack: 'My access is already provisioned. Can I just deploy on my existing grant like Marcus did, or do I have to get something re-approved first? The fix is time-sensitive.'
question: Can Priya deploy using her standing production-access grant, or must she obtain a fresh grant first?
choices: Deploy using the existing grant, because it was issued before PAP-4 took effect and remains valid until its 2025 recertification.
Obtain a fresh, re-attested grant before deploying, because the grant is subject to PAP-4's 90-day re-attestation rule and has lapsed.
Deploy using the shared break-glass account to bypass the access check, given the time pressure.
Escalate to the CISO to permanently exempt Priya from re-attestation before the deploy.
